# 污染物与噪声

_Pollutants & Engine Noise_

燃烧排放与推进噪声是两个相关但不同的研究方向。前者关注燃烧过程及排出物，后者还涉及喷流、风扇和其他部件的声源及传播。

_Combustion emissions and propulsion noise are related but distinct fields. Emissions concern combustion chemistry and exhaust products; noise also involves jets, fans, other components and sound propagation._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 把污染物形成机理、测量方法与评价指标分别整理。

_Separate pollutant-formation mechanisms, measurement methods and evaluation metrics._

- 区分源噪声、传播路径和接收点条件，注明工况。

_Distinguish sources, propagation paths and receiver conditions, and state the operating point._

- 阅读低排放或低噪声方案时，同时查看其对稳定性、效率和重量的影响。

_When assessing a low-emission or low-noise concept, also examine stability, efficiency and mass._
